name: AR_STATEMENT_DELIVERY
description: AR_STATEMENT_DELIVERY contains the information that is used for delivering customer statements via e-mail.

columns.name: STATEMENT_DELIVERY_ID
columns.description: A unique sequence number generated for the delivery details of the customer statements.

columns.name: SEND_TO_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer statement data.

columns.name: DELIVERY_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method used to deliver customer statements. Valid values are E-mail, Standard, and XML.

columns.name: CONTACT_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address of the customer bill-to contact  who receives customer statements.

columns.name: REPLY_TO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Reply-to e-mail address for customer statements delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: From e-mail address for customer statements delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: EMAIL_SUBJECT
columns.description: E-mail subject line for customer statements delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: EMAIL_BODY
columns.description: Body of the e-mail for customer statements delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: FROM_EMAIL_NAME
columns.description: Name of the from e-mail address for customer statements delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
